paper.title_en: Perturbative QCD Analysis for the Electric Dipole Moment of $Ξ$ and $Σ$ Hyperons from CP-Violating Dipole Interactions
paper.abstract_en: Hyperon electric dipole moments (EDMs) probe CP-violating interactions beyond the Standard Model. Motivated by the recent BESIII measurement [Ablikim et al., Science 393, 1027] and the perturbative QCD analysis of the $Λ$ EDM form factor $d_Λ$ [Chen et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 051902], we extend the perturbative QCD calculation of the EDM form factor to the $Ξ$ and $Σ$ hyperons. We derive factorization formulas from quark EDM and chromoelectric dipole moment contributions in terms of leading-twist light-cone distribution amplitudes (LCDAs). Using lattice-QCD results for the LCDAs and the strange-quark dipole moment ranges inferred from the BESIII $d_Λ$ bound and neutron EDM constraints, we obtain the conditional estimates $-4.8 \times 10^{-18} < d_{Ξ^-} < 1.8\times10^{-18}\,e\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $-6.1\times10^{-19} < d_{Σ^+} < 2.4\times10^{-19}\,e\,\mathrm{cm}$ at the scale of ${J/ψ}$ mass. Dedicated searches at BESIII and the future Super Tau-Charm Factory could further constrain these quark-level sources of CP violation.
